summary: This document records the Iceberg Spark integration updates, covering new features such as DSv2 validation, geometry bounds in Parquet writers, and runtime filtering improvements, along with bug fixes for ORC variant handling and vectorized reads. Participants largely agree on Option 3, which introduces these types for vectors while keeping them separate from general Iceberg primitives, and requires readers without native support to fall back to float or int. The discussion centers on an ambiguity in the Iceberg spec regarding Parquet files that contain field IDs for only some columns, leading to inconsistent behavior across Java, PyIceberg, Rust, and Go readers. The discussion proposes adding a new option to Spark streaming reads that allows an initial full snapshot load before incremental processing, improving performance for long-lived tables.
